title: Don’t Pay a Chinese Supplier Before Checking This
voice_style: clear international English, calm, practical, consultant-like, medium speed, low emotional intensity
visual_style: clean B2B card animation, white/gray background, supplier message card, checklist highlights, no fake factory footage

scenes.screen_text: Don’t Pay a Chinese Supplier Before Checking This
scenes.voiceover: A fast supplier reply is not proof.
scenes.visual_direction: White and light gray vertical card layout with a simple payment-before-checking warning marker. No factory footage.
scenes.animation_notes: Title fades in, then a small checklist icon appears under the title.

scenes.screen_text: Fast reply? Still check the details.
scenes.voiceover: Before you pay a Chinese supplier, slow down and check the reply carefully.
scenes.visual_direction: Show an illustrative supplier message card with a quick response timestamp and neutral blurred text blocks.
scenes.animation_notes: Message card slides up. Highlight moves from the timestamp to the checklist area.

scenes.voiceover: First, does the company name match the payment account?
scenes.visual_direction: Two clean fields appear side by side: company name and payment account name, using placeholder text only.
scenes.animation_notes: A comparison line connects the two fields, then a neutral question mark appears.

scenes.voiceover: Second, is the sample version clearly written, including model, material, size, or color?
scenes.visual_direction: Checklist card with model, material, size, and color rows. Use generic placeholders.
scenes.animation_notes: Rows enter one by one. Each row gets a soft highlight, not a success guarantee.

scenes.voiceover: Third, are packaging and logo details included, or still unclear?
scenes.visual_direction: Simple packaging card with label placeholders. Do not show real logos, private labels, or customer artwork.
scenes.animation_notes: Packaging outline appears. Logo field remains as a gray placeholder block.

scenes.voiceover: Fourth, when they say "7 days delivery", does that mean production time, shipping time, or arrival time?
scenes.visual_direction: Timeline with three labels: production, shipping, arrival. Keep the timeline illustrative.
scenes.animation_notes: The phrase "7 days delivery" lands on screen, then splits into three possible meanings.

scenes.voiceover: Fifth, will bulk production match the approved sample, or can details change later?
scenes.visual_direction: Two cards labeled sample and bulk production with matching detail rows and a small difference marker.
scenes.animation_notes: Cards align vertically. One row pulses to show a detail that needs confirmation.

scenes.screen_text: This is not proof of reliability.
scenes.voiceover: These checks do not prove whether a supplier is reliable.
scenes.visual_direction: Boundary note card on a plain background with calm, neutral typography.
scenes.animation_notes: Card fades in with no warning flash or dramatic effect.

scenes.screen_text: See the sample Supplier Reply Review report on Gewuji
scenes.voiceover: They only help you find unclear points before payment. See the sample Supplier Reply Review report on Gewuji.
scenes.visual_direction: Final CTA card with the Gewuji name and a clean link placeholder for the sample report.
scenes.animation_notes: CTA rises gently. Keep the tone informational, not sales-driven.
